conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, mera naam Ravi Kumar hai. Mera debit card last week se kaam nahi kar raha.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Ravi ji, main aapki help ke liye hoon. Kya aap bata sakte hain ki card kahaan use karne ki koshish ki thi?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, maine ek online shopping ki try ki, lekin har baar 'transaction declined' ka message aa raha hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Samjha. Kya aap apna card number bata sakte hain taaki main check kar sakoon?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Yeh lijiye, 2468-1357-2091-1234. Please jaldi dekho, mujhe yeh jaldi fix karwana hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Ji, maine dekh liya. Aapke card pe ek technical block hai. Main ise abhi unblock kar deta hoon. 2 ghante mein yeh work karne lagega.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Thanks, please sure karo ki yeh jaldi ho jaye.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Sheetal Sharma bol rahi hoon. Mere home loan ki EMI is mahine nahi kati, kya hua?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Sheetal ji, main aapki help karoonga. Kya aap apna loan account number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, yeh hai LN12345678. Maine auto-debit set kiya tha, phir bhi nahi hua.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Main check karta hoon. Ek minute... Lagta hai aapke account mein enough balance nahi tha. Kya aap confirm kar sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Arre, yeh kaise? Maine toh paise rakhe the. Kitna kam tha?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Almost ₹2,000 ki kami thi. Main suggest karta hoon ki balance daal ke dobara auto-debit try karo.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Theek hai, main aaj hi daal deti hoon. Thanks.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Rajesh Gupta. Mere credit card ka bill ₹10,000 zyada dikh raha hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Rajesh ji, sorry for the trouble. Kya aap bill ki date aur transaction details bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, 15 May ka bill hai. Ek transaction ₹10,000 ka hai, jo maine kiya hi nahi!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Samjha. Main check karta hoon. Lagta hai yeh ek fraud transaction ho sakta hai. Main ise block kar deta hoon aur refund process start karta hoon.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Please jaldi karo, yeh bahut pareshan karne wala hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Ji, main samajhta hoon. 7-10 din mein refund aapke account mein hoga. Main aapko update doonga.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Anita Verma. Maine ek FD kholi thi, lekin uska interest credit nahi hua.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Anita ji, main aapki FD details check karta hoon. Kya aap FD number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, FD123456. Yeh 6 mahine pehle kholi thi.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Thanks. Maine check kiya, aapki FD ka interest quarterly credit hota hai. Next credit agle hafte hoga.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Achha? Mujhe yeh bataya nahi gaya tha. Theek hai, thanks.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Sorry agar yeh clear nahi tha. Main aapko details mail kar deta hoon.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Vikas Singh. Mera ATM card kho gaya hai, ise block karo.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Vikas ji, main turant card block karta hoon. Please apna card number ya account number bata do.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Card number yaad nahi, lekin account number hai: 123456789012.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai, maine card block kar diya. Naya card 5 din mein aapke address pe aa jayega.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Shukriya, kitna charge hoga?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Pehla replacement free hai. Aapko koi charge nahi dena hoga.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Preeti Yadav. Mere account se ₹3,000 gayab hain, yeh kya mazaak hai?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Preeti ji, yeh sunke sorry laga. Please apna account number bata do taaki main check kar sakoon.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, yeh hai 987654321098. Jaldi dekho, main bahut pareshan hoon.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine dekha, ₹3,000 ka ek online transaction hua hai. Kya aapne koi payment kiya tha?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Nahi, maine kuch nahi kiya! Yeh fraud hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Chinta mat karo, main ise fraud case mein register karta hoon aur refund process start karta hoon.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Sanjay Mishra. Mera credit card limit kyun kam ho gaya?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Sanjay ji, main aapki card details check karta hoon. Please card number bata do.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: 4567-9012-6831-5678. Pehle 2 lakh thi, ab 1.5 lakh dikh raha hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Ji, maine dekha. Aapki recent payment history ke basis pe limit adjust ki gayi hai. Kya aap ise badhwana chahte hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, ise wapas 2 lakh karo.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai, main request register karta hoon. 3-5 din mein update ho jayega.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Neha Joshi. Mera loan application reject kyun hua?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Neha ji, main aapke application ka status check karta hoon. Please apna application number bata do.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Yeh hai APN456789. Mujhe koi reason nahi bataya gaya.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine check kiya. Aapka CIBIL score requirement se kam tha. Kya aap ise improve karne ke liye tips chahti hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, please batao. Yeh bahut zaroori hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Ji, main aapko credit improvement ke tips mail karta hoon aur dobara application ke liye guide karoonga.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Ajay Verma. Mera savings account ka passbook update nahi hua hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Ajay ji, main aapki help karoonga. Please apna account number bata do.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, 456789123456. Last 2 mahine ka record nahi dikh raha.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine check kiya. Aapka passbook update system mein pending hai. Kya aap branch mein aa sakte hain ya digital statement chahiye?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Digital statement bhej do.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai, main ise aapke registered email pe bhej deta hoon.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Kavita Mehta. Mere credit card ke reward points redeem kaise karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Kavita ji, main aapko guide karta hoon. Kya aap apna card number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, 1102-2034-5556-9012. Mere paas 5000 points hain.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Great! Aap hamare app ya website pe login karke reward section mein jaake points redeem kar sakti hain. Kya main steps mail karoon?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, please mail karo.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Ji, main aapko detailed guide mail kar deta hoon. Aur koi question?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Nahi, bas itna hi. Thanks.
